One part has a form: in 02 §9 shaping the rule is selected at a step exactly where what comes back to the shapers alone covers its cost, whatever comes to every member alike, and with nothing back and a cost their share falls: a narrow gain selects, a shared one does not. Many coalitions accumulating, a drag on growth and sweeping by shock have no form; groups that form and gains across domains are Open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts). Shaping gives s to the shapers alone and p to every member alike and costs each shaper c; at a step the rule favours the shapers exactly where c ≤ s, whatever p; with nothing coming back and a cost their share falls strictly. That actual institutions carry such a capacity is a premise; the record names Olson (1965), rent-seeking and regulatory capture as neighbours.
Open: graded capacities to shape the rule, groups that form or assort by the share, a gain growing with the number of domains captured, gains passing between domains.
